description:
## 1.0.0 (2026-11-14)

### ✨ New Features

* High-rate GNSS patches for NAVER Map and KakaoMap ([052cf29](https://github.com/ocel07/kmaps-nav-patches/commit/052cf29570c39148b524eadbd2115c7d2fde0eba))

patches.name: NAVER Map high-rate GNSS
patches.description: Runs map matching on every new GNSS fix (max 20 Hz) with time-weighted counters and requests location updates every 125 ms.

patches.name: KakaoMap high-rate GNSS
patches.description: Lets the location SDK use every GNSS fix (up to 25 Hz) while KNSDK keeps its 1 Hz origin rate, and fixes a map-matching result chain that leaked memory for the whole drive.
